retirements.reason: Fenie corrected this station's latitude, so its coordinate-derived ID changed. The refresh gate rejected every candidate from 2026-10-22 onward because this one baseline ID had no match, and the identity rule only carries an ID forward within 250 m.
retirements.evidence: The 2026-10-24 refresh candidate holds the same Fenie code (0870), name and station page (recarga.fenieenergia.es/punto-recarga/0870) under the successor ID. Only the latitude differs, 40.4379 in the baseline and 40.46817 in the candidate, about 3.4 km. References to the old ID were not checked.
